title: Forest, built on what the best apps do
question: Each applies the research: one hero number with small cents, colour only for status, a pill at today on the pace line, familiar rows. They differ in light, dark, and how the top is framed.

options.label: G · Forest Light
options.lineage: Copilot Money and Apple's grouped screens
options.thesis: Sage-grey ground, white cards, deep green only for what you tap; the pace line carries a pill at today.
options.viewport: Free to spend €1.180 with small cents, per-day line; pace line with '€84 over' pill at today; Needs you rows with icons; Still to pay; groups as three slim bars.
options.risk: Closest to Copilot; its own character rests on the green and the feel.

options.label: H · Forest Night
options.lineage: bunq and Copilot's dark modes, warm, no neon
options.thesis: The same screen in deep green-black; mint for the line, amber for today.
materials: cards with a faint top highlight
options.viewport: Same layout as G, dark: number in warm white, mint pace line, amber dot and pill at today.
options.risk: Dark money apps drift toward the neon look; it stays warm only if glow is kept to the one dot.

options.label: I · Forest Wash
options.lineage: Copilot's coloured top fading into the page
options.thesis: A soft green wash behind the number and line, fading into the page; centred number; groups as three rings.
options.viewport: Centred €1.180 on a green wash, pace line across the full width, three rings for needs/wants/savings, then Needs you and Still to pay.
options.risk: The wash is a gradient on chrome; it must stay one soft colour, or it tips into the AI look.
